description: This file defines HTTP route handlers for managing browser profiles and browser lifecycle operations in a web server, including listing profiles, starting/stopping browsers, resetting profiles, and creating/deleting profiles.

methods.name: handleBrowserRouteError
methods.description: Handles errors during browser route processing by mapping errors to HTTP responses.

methods.name: withBasicProfileRoute
methods.description: Executes a profile-related operation with error handling, resolving the profile context.

methods.name: withProfilesServiceMutation
methods.description: Executes a mutation on the profiles service with error handling.

methods.name: registerBrowserBasicRoutes
methods.description: Registers HTTP route handlers for browser profile management and control.
